blocks.text: Galvanometer current ko detect karne (pakarne) wala instrument (aala) hai. Hum is ki internal structure (andar ki banawat) aur kaam karne ka tareeqa nahi parhenge; sirf is ke istemal dekhenge. Yeh aksar null method mein circuits ki accurate (theek theek) measurement (naap) ke liye istemal hota hai. Null method mein circuit ko tab tak badalte hain jab tak galvanometer deflection na dikhaye, yani zero reading de. Iska matlab hai ke circuit mein required (zaroori) condition (shart) poori ho gayi. Is halat mein galvanometer ke dono siron ka potential barabar hota hai. Galvanometer ki apni resistance hoti hai, magar null reading par us ka koi asar nahi hota, kyun ke us waqt us mein se koi current nahi guzarta. Null method bridge circuits, jaise Wheatstone bridge aur potentiometer, mein aam hai.

Pichle hisse mein dekha ke Wheatstone bridge mein unknown (na-maloom) resistance null method se naapi jati hai. Galvanometer opposite (aamne saamne ke) sides ke mid-points (beech ke points) ke darmiyan laga hota hai. Badalne wali resistance ko tab tak badalte hain jab tak galvanometer deflection na dikhaye. Is waqt bridge balanced hota hai aur unknown resistance maloom resistances ki ratio (nisbat) se nikal aati hai.

Potentiometer mein null method se unknown voltage ko ek maloom reference voltage se compare (muqabla) kar ke naapa jata hai; yeh reference voltage potentiometer ke taar par laga hota hai. Taar par contact ke liye galvanometer aur jockey (sarakne wala contact) istemal hote hain. Null point par jockey aur taar ke sire ke darmiyan potential difference unknown voltage ke barabar hota hai. Jockey ki jagah se unknown voltage naap liya jata hai.
Null method mein galvanometer ke kuch advantages (faide) hain:

items: Null method galvanometer ki apni (internal) resistance ka asar khatam kar deta hai, is liye reading zyada accurate hoti hai.
Galvanometer bohat sensitive (hassas) hote hain aur 10⁻⁶ ampere jitne chhote currents bhi pakar lete hain.
“No deflection” balance ki seedha aur saaf sign (nishani) hai, is liye null point pehchanna aasaan hai.

blocks.prompt: Null measurement par galvanometer ki resistance asar kyun nahi karti?
blocks.explanation: Null point par galvanometer se koi current nahi guzarta, is liye us ki resistance par potential ka koi girna (IR) nahi hota. Balance ki condition sirf doosri resistances ya lengths par depend karti hai, galvanometer ki resistance chahe kitni bhi ho.

items: Galvanometer current pakarta hai; null method mein circuit ko zero deflection tak badalte hain, jab us ke dono sire ek potential par hon aur us ki resistance ka asar na ho.
Advantages: resistance ka asar khatam, taqreeban 10⁻⁶ A tak pakarta hai, saaf balance point.
